Dani (People Ops): FYI Riley submitted a request for a standing desk + temporary 60% schedule for 6 weeks after minor outpatient surgery. Adding @Kofi to coordinate coverage and timeline.

Kofi (Manager): Thanks. Do we need a medical note? Also worried about sprint work and a small project deadline next week.

Dani (People Ops): We ask for a short provider note (can be uploaded to the secure portal). We can provisionally approve the desk and the reduced schedule for up to 6 weeks while docs come in. Keep this confidential.

Riley (Employee): I can upload the note tonight. For the reduced hours, would prefer 9am-3pm MWF. That matches my appointments. Happy to shift a few tasks to teammates.

Kofi (Manager): MWF 9-3 should work. @Sam can Facilities deliver a sit-stand desk by Thursday? Also I'll reassign the client demos to Alex for the week.

Sam (Facilities): We have a short lead time. Can deliver a sit-stand frame + monitor riser by Thursday EOD. Need office location and contact.

Dani (People Ops): Manager checklist (drop-in):
```
- accommodation_type: standing desk + reduced-hours
- provisional_period: 6 weeks
- schedule: MWF 9:00-15:00
- documentation_needed: provider note upload
- coverage_plan: reassign demos to Alex; adjust pairing
- checkins: weekly 1:1 with manager
- privacy: note stored in People Ops private folder
```

Dani (People Ops): Quick note on performance cycles: accommodations must be annotated in calibration guidance so reviewers consider context. Document any change in scope or missed deliverables and the support actions taken. We will not use the accommodation as a negative in calibration.

Kofi (Manager): Got it. I'll update the sprint board and ping Alex. Riley, thanks for flagging—feel better soon.

Riley (Employee): Thanks everyone. I'll upload the note tonight and confirm my office desk location. :pray:

hr-bot: Reminder - upload medical note here: https://redwood.company/handbook/accommodations (secure portal).
